binary_reference.comparison_rule: reuse all five pre-registered seed-matched development runs

claim_boundary: Exploratory train/validation comparison only. The current SAbDab2 test cannot support a never-read or confirmatory claim; no external generalization, benchmark improvement, or state-of-the-art claim is authorized.

controlled_architecture.backbone: the same two parameter-unshared full-relative-pose intra-chain encoders and late bidirectional cross-attention used by the binary hybrid reference
controlled_architecture.pair_factorization: one distogram head; contact probability is the exact sum of registered near-distance-bin probabilities, never a separately parameterized mask head
controlled_architecture.residue_head: zero-gated intra-chain unary plus noisy-OR contact marginal
controlled_architecture.triangle_geometry: symmetric reverse triangle inequality using only known intra-chain C-alpha distances and predicted inter-chain expected distances
controlled_architecture.triangle_region: expanded IMGT CDR residues by isolated-antigen surface residues inside a 12-Angstrom patch seeded by intra-chain epitope-unary logits

epoch_metrics.fixed_operating_point: raw logit zero for every epoch and condition
threshold_free: contact pooled and mean per-complex AUPRC
epitope and paratope pooled and macro AUPRC
contact P@10, P@Lmin/10, P@Lmin/5, P@Lmin and recalls

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum validation cluster-weighted directional interaction-only margin; break ties within 0.0001 by validation mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.selection_unit: seed and condition; current SAbDab2 test is unavailable

primary_hypothesis: Distogram supervision will improve validation contact AUPRC and calibration; CDR-by-monomer-surface-patch triangle consistency will preferentially reduce geometrically isolated false positives, increasing P@K and fixed-threshold precision while retaining at least 95% of the paired-seed recall of the unregularized distogram condition.
promotion_rule: Report five paired seeds against the frozen binary hybrid reference. The triangle condition is promoted only if contact AUPRC/P@K and precision improve without recall ratio below 0.95 or a materially worse reciprocal margin.
research_question: Does a single distogram head whose near-distance bins exactly project to contact probability outperform a binary contact head, and does a pose-free local triangle constraint improve precision without materially reducing recall?

training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: wrong partners are ranking examples and never receive fabricated all-zero contact or distance labels
